contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_link_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `link` BEGIN DELETE FROM `link_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_link_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `link` BEGIN DELETE FROM `link_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_link_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `link` BEGIN INSERT INTO `link_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `description`, `contentHtml`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`description`, NEW.`contentHtml`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_link_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `link` BEGIN INSERT INTO `link_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `description`, `contentHtml`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`description`, NEW.`contentHtml`); END
entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `contentHtml` TEXT, content=`link`)
